The main takeaway from our work is that
large-scale structure boosting is an important effect to consider when interpreting number counts of high-redshift populations, especially at the bright end of the counts.

, when dealing with the faintest flux densities probed by current and upcoming surveys, the effects of lensing by the large-scale structure of the Universe should be taken into account in order to properly interpret the data.
